title: KINGS ON THE RUN Sport Fishing
specs: Fishing for King Salmon (Chinook Salmon) with fish often between 20-30lbs and some exceeding 40lbs
Launch from a Toronto marina, close to the city
blurb: Guests fish for Lake Ontario Salmon including King Salmon, Atlantic Salmon, Rainbow Trout, Lake Trout, Coho Salmon, and Brown Trout. Charters run from mid April through the end of October, launching from a Toronto marina. Trips can be half day or longer, with a focus on trolling for King Salmon.
